questions.q: What is special about this video, according to the author?
o: She prepared discounts for the viewers
She shows purchases from a market
questions.e: In the video: "današnji video je poseban jer sam pripremila popuste za vas" — today's video is special because I have prepared discounts for you.

questions.q: What did she order first for the living room?
o: A set of chair covers and a tablecloth
questions.e: In the video: "naručila sam ovaj set za dnevnu sobu, za stolice i stolnjak" — I ordered this set for the living room, for the chairs and a tablecloth.

questions.q: Why does she like leg warmers and tights so much?
o: They are fashionable in her town
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam jako zimogrozna" — I am very sensitive to cold.

questions.q: Why does she need a chocolate mold?
questions.e: In the video: "zato što volim da pravim Dubai čokoladu" — because I like making Dubai chocolate.

questions.q: Why did she buy a burgundy handbag?
o: It has been her favorite color since childhood
questions.e: In the video: "Bordo je u trendu." — Burgundy is trendy.

questions.q: Who did she order the jump rope for?
questions.e: In the video: "Vijaču sam naručila mom dečku." — I ordered the jump rope for my boyfriend.

questions.q: Why does she take several screen protectors at once?
questions.e: In the video: "stalno mi se lomi" — mine keeps breaking.

questions.q: What does she say about diamond painting?
o: It is a very expensive hobby
questions.e: In the video: "i meni je to jako opuštajuće" — and I find it very relaxing.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Besplatna *dostava*, brzo stižu paketi
questions.e: dostava — delivery.

questions.q: i dobijete *stolnjak*
questions.e: stolnjak — tablecloth.

questions.q: Ja sam jako *zimogrozna*
questions.e: zimogrozan — someone who gets cold easily.

questions.q: Volim *hulahopke*, nosim zimi.
questions.e: hulahopke — tights.

questions.q: Ovo su organizatori za *fioke*
questions.e: fioka — a drawer.

questions.q: Dobijete *daljinski*, LED sijalice
questions.e: daljinski (upravljač) — remote control.

questions.q: Dobije se *pinceta*
questions.e: pinceta — tweezers.

questions.q: Prelepa je i jedva čekam da je završim
questions.e: prelepa — very beautiful.

questions.q: naručila sam ovaj set ___ dnevnu sobu
questions.e: set za + acc. — a set for the living room.

questions.q: Inače ___ nas ovo staklo košta preko hiljadu dinara
questions.e: kod nas — at our place (in our country).

questions.q: Sad ću odmah čim ___ snimanje da je stavim
questions.e: After čim a perfective verb is needed: završim.

questions.q: Jako je ___ materijal, kao vuna
questions.e: materijal is masculine, so lep.

questions.t: Choose the correct form of the word
questions.q: Imam neke bordo ___, džemperiće
questions.e: Direct object, acc. pl.: haljine.

questions.t: Choose the correct form of the word
questions.q: Vijaču sam naručila mom ___
questions.e: To whom? Dative: mom dečku.

questions.t: Choose the correct form of the word
questions.q: Ubacite u veš ___ i onda možete kao više boja
questions.e: ubaciti u + acc. (where to?): u mašinu.

questions.q: Ja sam ih uvek ___
questions.e: A woman is speaking: nosila (fem.).
